title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 161  An Act Providing for the Establishment of a School of Fisheries in the Municipality of Obando, Province of Bulacan, to Be Known as the Obando School of Fisheries, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

text.en:
There shall be established under the direct supervision of the Bureau of Secondary Education,
Ministry of Education and Culture, a school of fisheries in the Municipality of Obando, Province of Bulacan,
to be known as the Obando School of Fisheries.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 for the Ministry of
Education and Culture intended for new national schools. Starting Calendar Year 1983 such sum as may be
necessary for the operation and maintenance of the school shall be provided in the annual General
Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
